# Awesome Grok Bot

> Live x.ai/bot shares you can Add, plus writeups of how people actually run them.

Human index: https://github.com/majiayu000/awesome-grok-bot

Featured notes: templates/
Vetting: docs/vetting.md
Team recipes (one share = one bot): packs/
Official role starters (not importable): docs/official-starters.md
Field cases sit above the 377 shares (real runs, grouped by roster / computer-use / gotchas): README.md#field-cases
Linux laptop app: no official Grok Bot app for Linux laptops; the Bot computer is already Linux in the cloud; unofficial thin-client ports are indexed at falser101/grok-bot-linux: README.md#linux-laptop-app
Skills and tools (local/study, factory, CLIs, bridges, playbooks, indexes, OSS alts): README.md#skills-and-tools
Official docs: README.md#official-docs
Community tutorials: README.md#tutorials
